acceptance: A wave of 2 shipped cycles and 1 failed cycle reports llm_minutes_per_shipped_cycle as the sum of duration_ms of all 3 cycles in minutes, divided by 2, rounded to 0.1.
The measures report fresh tokens (input + output + cache_write) and cache_read tokens for each shipped cycle, and the count of rows whose usage_status is not measured.
The measures report audit_rounds_per_cycle from audit_dispatches and convergence_rate as shipped cycles / started cycles.
A wave with 0 shipped cycles reports the cost as not defined, not as 0 and not as a division error.
evolve wave status --json carries the new fields, and the text output prints one cost line.
fix: Read llm-calls.ndjson and the ship outcome of each cycle of the wave in cmd_wave_measures.go, next to the run records that it reads today. Pass the sums into wavemeasure.Facts; wavemeasure stays pure and computes the measures. Print them in the text and JSON of the wave measures.
notes: Rank 1 of the plan: the other components need its numbers. Lane-safe: wavemeasure and cmd_wave_measures.go are not on the fence.
routed_reason: ADR-0158 plan section 6: no fence path to change; a fenced call site is a split
source: console, 2026-10-27, operator request on cycle 2035 ("balance to cost and output"). ADR-0158; plan docs/plans/cost-aware-repair-2026-10.md
summary: evolve wave status prints no cost figure. Waves 141 and 142 cost 101.2 LLM minutes for each shipped cycle, and the console had to sum llm-calls.ndjson by hand. Add the cost measures to wavemeasure.Measures, from the llm-calls.ndjson of each cycle of the wave and its ship record, so the shadow stages of ADR-0158 have a before and an after number.
title: The wave measures give the LLM minutes and tokens for each shipped cycle, the audit rounds and the convergence rate (ADR-0158)
